_doc: Major IDs as the build score counts them (Damage, MajorIds). Two copies of one major ID count once; different ones add up.
status: scored (in the score), partial (part of it is), unscored (an ability, special or stat the model does not count),
ally (helps others only), utility (movement, control, looks). measure: what to measure in game before it can be scored better.
spell / main / passive: x on spell, main attack and summon damage; cost: x on the spells' mana cost (expected);
health: x on max health; madness: a random class spell every N s; requires: a tree node the effect needs.
targets: a spell (rules.model.spells) or a summon or area of the tree, by name: add (per hit, element fractions),
cast (once a cast), set + hits (in place of its own hits), mult, duration and ticks (lasting spells).
summon: a new summon (conv per hit, rate a second, count, mainAttack % each).

Sorcery.note: 25% chance to cast again for free: x1.25 expected on spells and the main attack. The repeat comes 2 s later and cannot repeat itself; a lasting spell (Totem) and summons stay x1, a second Totem only replaces the first.

Self-sufficient.measure: powder specials are not in the model: how often the special fires (8%/s) and its damage

Tackle.note: Collide +150% neutral, +60% thunder, +10% fire, counted on half the Flying Kicks as Collide is (the ability table).
Tackle.measure: how often a Flying Kick throws the mob into a wall

Furious Effigy.note: Totem ticks twice as fast for half as long: the same damage a cast in half the time (x2 a second), recast twice as often (its mana counts double).
Furious Effigy.measure: whether the Totem's other effects (Regeneration, puppets, Aura) also speed up

Flain Remnants.note: Counted as 3 Remnants out (at most 5, each lasts 20 s): each shoots 95% neutral a second and gives the main attack +15%, as summons are (out a share of the fight).
Flain Remnants.measure: how many Remnants are out in a fight, and whether the +15% main attack stacks per Remnant

Orbwalk.note: +20% neutral and +20% air on each Lightweaver orb hit; the slower orbs are not counted.
Orbwalk.measure: Lightweaver orb hits a second with Orbwalk

Blinding Lights.note: Ophanim orbs at 250% damage (read as x2.5, the lower reading, not +250%), still counted with each main attack though they orbit.
Blinding Lights.measure: Ophanim orb hits a second while orbiting

Brutal Blow.measure: Armour Breaker's uptime with half duration and 5 s less cooldown

Madness.note: A random spell of your class every 3 s: the class's spells' casts added up over how many spells it has, every 3 s. Movement spells and a Totem already up add nothing.
Madness.measure: which spells Madness can pick, and whether it skips movement spells

Manic Edge.measure: Surprise Strike's damage after a Vanish (3% per mana lost, up to 70%)

Regicide.note: +2.5% damage a block from the target: counted at 8 blocks (+20%), the low end of a bow's range.
Regicide.measure: the usual distance to the target in a fight (2.5% a block, at most 150%)
